description: Phase 6: Admin Console at /manage/. Build platform admin dashboard with Chart.js statistics (users, jobs, applications over time), user management (list, detail, activate/deactivate), company management (approve/reject companies), job management with moderation queue (if JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED), JobReport model for spam/inappropriate reports, ContactMessage model for contact form, AuditLog model for admin action tracking, and moderation queue views.
steps: 1. Create JobReport model in jobs/models.py with FK to Job, FK to reporter User, reason CharField choices (SPAM, INAPPROPRIATE, FRAUD, OTHER), description TextField, status CharField choices (PENDING, REVIEWED, RESOLVED, DISMISSED), created_at, reviewed_at, reviewed_by FK to User nullable. Add indexes on status and created_at.
2. Create ContactMessage model in core/models.py with name, email, subject, message TextField, is_read BooleanField default False, created_at, responded_at nullable. Add index on is_read.

3. Create AuditLog model in core/models.py with user FK to User, action CharField (e.g., 'USER_DEACTIVATED', 'COMPANY_APPROVED', 'JOB_APPROVED'), target_model CharField, target_id PositiveIntegerField, details JSONField, timestamp DateTimeField auto_now_add. Add index on user and timestamp.
4. Create ReportJobForm in jobs/forms.py with reason choices and description, Bootstrap styling
5. Create ContactForm in core/forms.py with name, email, subject, message fields, Bootstrap styling
6. Create core/services.py with AuditLogService class containing log_action(user, action, target_model, target_id, details) method

7. Create admin views in dashboard/views.py or new admin_views.py: AdminDashboardView (ADMIN only, stats with Chart.js), UserListView (ADMIN only, paginated user list with search/filter), UserDetailView (ADMIN only, show user info, activate/deactivate action), CompanyManagementListView (ADMIN only, companies with status filter), CompanyApprovalView (ADMIN only, approve/reject company with reason), JobManagementListView (ADMIN only, all jobs), JobModerationQueueView (ADMIN only, jobs with is_approved=False if JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED), JobApprovalView (ADMIN only, approve/reject job), JobReportsListView (ADMIN only, list reports with status filter), JobReportDetailView (ADMIN only, review report, mark as resolved/dismissed), ContactMessagesListView (ADMIN only, list messages with unread filter), ContactMessageDetailView (ADMIN only, mark as read), AuditLogListView (ADMIN only, filterable log of all admin actions)
8. Create public ReportJobView (authenticated users can report jobs) and ContactView (public contact form submission)

9. Create AdminDashboardService in dashboard/services.py with methods: get_user_stats() (total, active, by role, new this month), get_job_stats() (total, active, by status, posted this month), get_application_stats() (total, by status, this month), get_chart_data_users_over_time() (returns JSON for Chart.js), get_chart_data_jobs_over_time(), get_chart_data_applications_over_time()
10. Update Company approve/reject views to use AuditLogService.log_action
11. Update Job approve/reject views to use AuditLogService.log_action
12. Update User activate/deactivate views to use AuditLogService.log_action

13. Create URL patterns in dashboard/urls.py: manage/ (admin dashboard), manage/users/, manage/users/<int:pk>/, manage/users/<int:pk>/toggle-active/, manage/companies/, manage/companies/<int:pk>/approve/, manage/companies/<int:pk>/reject/, manage/jobs/, manage/jobs/moderation-queue/, manage/jobs/<int:pk>/approve/, manage/jobs/<int:pk>/reject/, manage/reports/, manage/reports/<int:pk>/, manage/contact/, manage/contact/<int:pk>/, manage/audit-logs/
14. Create URL patterns in jobs/urls.py: <int:pk>/report/ (report job), and in core/urls.py: contact/ (contact form)

15. Create templates: dashboard/admin_dashboard.html (with Chart.js charts for users/jobs/applications over time, stat cards), dashboard/user_list.html, dashboard/user_detail.html (with activate/deactivate button), dashboard/company_management.html (with approve/reject actions), dashboard/job_moderation_queue.html (pending jobs), dashboard/job_report_list.html, dashboard/job_report_detail.html (with resolve/dismiss actions), dashboard/contact_messages.html, dashboard/contact_message_detail.html, dashboard/audit_log_list.html (filterable table)
16. Create templates: jobs/report_job.html (report form), core/contact.html (contact form with map placeholder)
17. Add Chart.js CDN to admin dashboard template
18. Add admin menu items to navbar for ADMIN role (Dashboard, Users, Companies, Jobs, Reports, Contact, Logs)
19. Run makemigrations for new models
20. Run migrate
21. Write tests for admin permission checks (non-admin cannot access), audit log creation, company approval, job moderation
acceptance_criteria: Admin dashboard at /manage/ shows statistics cards (total users, active jobs, applications) and Chart.js line charts for users/jobs/applications over last 30 days
User management: admins can list/search users, view details, activate/deactivate accounts
Company management: admins can list companies, filter by status, approve/reject with optional reason
Job management: admins can list all jobs
Job moderation queue: if JOB_MODERATION_ENABLED=True, shows jobs with is_approved=False; admins can approve/reject
JobReport model allows users to report jobs; admins can review reports and mark as resolved/dismissed
ContactMessage model stores contact form submissions; admins can view and mark as read
AuditLog tracks all admin actions (user activate/deactivate, company approve/reject, job approve/reject) with user, action, target, timestamp
Public contact form at /contact/ with name, email, subject, message fields
Authenticated users can report jobs at /jobs/<id>/report/ with reason and description
All admin views enforce ADMIN role permission (redirect or 403 for non-admins)
Tests verify permission enforcement and audit log creation
